word.description: The word to be spelled. Lowercase unless a proper noun. Single word only - no spaces or hyphens.

tier.description: Difficulty tier, which maps 1:1 onto the round number.

respelling.description: Plain-English phonetic respelling with the stressed syllable in CAPS, e.g. 'kuh-TAS-truh-fee'. No IPA.

origin.description: Short language of origin, read aloud verbatim by the pronouncer.

definition.description: One concise sentence. Must NOT contain the word itself or an obvious cognate giveaway.

sentence.description: A short, natural sentence using the word.

alsoAccepted.description: Alternate spellings that must be ruled correct. Shown to the pronouncer as a warning.

notes.description: Optional guidance for the pronouncer (homophone traps, alternate pronunciations, etc.).
